name: Ndifreke Akpan
intro: I design brand identities, packaging, flyers and social content that make businesses look as good as they are.

availability.full_time_note: Open to full-time and contract roles

hire.heading: Join your team
hire.body: I'm open to full-time and contract design roles, remote or on-site. I can own a brand day to day, keep a busy content calendar looking consistent, and work closely with marketing and product teams.

freelance.heading: Hire me for a project
freelance.body: Need something designed without hiring full-time? I take on projects with a clear brief, a fixed quote and an agreed deadline.

process.heading: How I work
process.intro: Every project follows the same loop. Feedback isn't the end of the process, it's what sends the work back for another, better round.

steps.title: Inspiration
steps.body: I study the brief, the audience and what's around them, and collect references before I draw anything.

steps.title: Design
steps.body: I sketch, build directions and turn the strongest ideas into real layouts and mockups.

steps.title: Client feedback
steps.body: You see the work and tell me what's working and what isn't. Every note gets an answer.

steps.title: Final delivery
steps.body: Once it's right, you get every file you need, ready for print, web and social.

process.loop_label: Back to design for another round

about.heading: About me
about.body:
I'm Ndifreke Akpan, a graphic designer based in Nigeria. I work across brand identity, packaging, print and social media, for companies and for independent clients.

I care about design that does a job: a label that stands out on a crowded shelf, a flyer that gets people to call, a brand that looks consistent everywhere it shows up.

contact.heading: Let's talk
contact.body: Tell me about the role or the project. I'll reply within a day.

seo.title: Ndifreke Akpan, graphic designer
seo.description: Graphic designer in Nigeria. Brand identity, packaging, flyers and social media design. Open to full-time roles and freelance projects.
